tasks.label: Check VitalSense App Status
args: try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5000' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host 'Status:' $response.StatusCode; Write-Host 'Content Length:' $response.Content.Length; Write-Host 'Title:' ($response.Content | Select-String '<title>(.*?)</title>').Matches[0].Groups[1].Value } catch { Write-Host 'Error:' $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: Simple Health Check
args: try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5000' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host 'Status:' $response.StatusCode; Write-Host 'Content Length:' $response.Content.Length; } catch { Write-Host 'Error:' $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: VitalSense App Health Check
args: Write-Host '🔍 Checking VitalSense App Status...'; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5000' -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Host '✅ Status:' $response.StatusCode; Write-Host '📄 Content Length:' $response.Content.Length 'bytes'; if ($response.Content -like '*VitalSense*') { Write-Host '🎯 VitalSense branding detected' } else { Write-Host '⚠️  VitalSense branding not found' }; if ($response.Content -like '*Health Score*') { Write-Host '💓 Health Score detected' } else { Write-Host '⚠️  Health Score not found' } } catch { Write-Host '❌ Error:' $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: Quick App Check
args: try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest 'http://localhost:5000' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host 'Status:' $r.StatusCode; Write-Host 'Size:' $r.Content.Length 'bytes' } catch { Write-Host 'Error:' $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: Final VitalSense Check
args: Write-Host 'VitalSense App Status Check'; Write-Host '========================'; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest 'http://localhost:5000' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host 'Status: ✅' $r.StatusCode; Write-Host 'Content: 📄' $r.Content.Length 'bytes'; Write-Host 'App is responding correctly' } catch { Write-Host 'Status: ❌ Error -' $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: Debug VitalSense Status
args: Write-Host '🔍 VitalSense Development Check'; Write-Host '================================'; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest 'http://localhost:5000' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host '✅ Status:' $response.StatusCode; Write-Host '📄 Size:' $response.Content.Length 'bytes'; $title = [regex]::Match($response.Content, '<title>(.*?)</title>').Groups[1].Value; if ($title) { Write-Host '📋 Title:' $title } else { Write-Host '⚠️  No title found' }; Write-Host '🎯 App responding correctly' } catch { Write-Host '❌ Connection failed:' $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: Simple Content Check
args: try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest 'http://localhost:5000' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host 'Status:' $r.StatusCode; Write-Host 'Size:' $r.Content.Length; Write-Host 'First 200 chars:'; Write-Host $r.Content.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(200, $r.Content.Length)) } catch { Write-Host 'Error:' $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: probe-analytics-ping-8789
args: try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest 'http://127.0.0.1:8789/api/_analytics_ping' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host 'Status:' $r.StatusCode; Write-Host 'Body:' $r.Content } catch { Write-Host 'Caught:' $_.Exception.Message }
